card.name: Linking words before metal ions and binders
card.fires_on: Small linking words (to, other, as, with, by, an) right before a mineral, metal ion, binder or vitamin term, mostly in interaction or chelation text.

modes.label: Before cations and binders
modes.description: Linking word just before calcium, aluminum, magnesium, metal cations or phosphate binders.
modes.example: Baloxavir may form a chelate with polyvalent cations such<< as>> calcium, aluminum, or magnesium.

modes.label: Before other drug or chemical names
modes.description: Linking word in a list or mechanism sentence ahead of a named agent or biochemical target.
modes.example: Ceftriaxone can displace bilirubin from its binding<< to>> serum albumin, leading to a risk
